versions.short: The bill would require the Chairman of the Board of Veterans' Appeals to report each year on why certain appeals under the newer appeals system were not decided on time, and why appeals before the Board were sent back for further work, including the number and percentage of cases each reason affected. It would also require the Board to publish a weekly notice on a Department of Veterans Affairs website listing the docket dates of cases assigned to a Board member for decision that week, with a statement that such an assignment does not mean a decision will be issued that week. Cases that have been advanced or remanded by the United States Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims would be excluded from that weekly notice.
